name: Animals
description: Vertebrate and invertebrate animal subjects — mammals, birds, reptiles, amphibians, fish, cephalopods, crustaceans. Covers anything in Kingdom Animalia except Insects (separate niche, since insect content has its own visual + narrative conventions). The default niche for Bound-style 'Why It Sucks To Be Born As X' explainers since the reference channel is animal-heavy.
tagline: Born hunted, hungry, or weirdly built.
visualStyleSheet: All subjects are animals rendered as expressive cartoons with accurate species anatomy — correct skeletal proportions, accurate pelage / feathers / scales, species-typical posture. One expressive face per subject (real eye placement, real mouth structure — do NOT default to human-cartoon mascot eyes for non-vertebrate subjects). Thick uneven black ink outline, flat solid color fills with minimal cel-shading. Background is a simple solid color, gradient, or single-element environmental cue (savanna grass, ice floe, branch, ocean blue).
negativePromptAddendum: no human characters in the same frame as the subject, no fantasy-creature stylings (no glowing eyes, no impossible color palettes unless the species really has them), no anthropomorphic clothing or accessories
audienceHint: viewers who like nature trivia, wildlife documentaries, and the dark-humor side of animal biology
scriptContext: This is a video about a specific animal species. Narration can use light anthropomorphism for humor ('it spends every breeding season regretting its choices') but must always ground claims in real biology — cite specific anatomy, behavior, lifecycle stages, or known field-study findings.
